title: Empty library, test clock
environment: An in-memory SQLite database (node:sqlite), with the services, the outbox and the policies' event handlers over it; no server.
records: None: no members, tools or loans. The clock starts at 05:00 on Monday 2 March 2026 in New York, the library's default time zone.
prepare: services() makes a fresh store, clock and outbox for the test; the test registers the members and adds the tools it needs, and moves the clock.
reset: Nothing to reset: each test's database is its own and lives only in memory.
description: The domain rule tests' starting point: the model, the command handlers and the outbox, with time under the test's control.

title: Empty library over HTTP
environment: The HTTP API on a free port of 127.0.0.1, over an in-memory SQLite database (node:sqlite), with a test clock.
records: None: no members, tools or loans. The clock starts at 05:00 on Monday 2 March 2026 in New York, the library's default time zone.
prepare: startApi() in beforeEach starts the server; the test registers members and adds tools through the API.
reset: api.close() in afterEach closes the server and the database.
description: The acceptance tests' starting point: the whole API, called over HTTP as a client would.
